entry.title: Esagila
entry.note: Reconstruction of the Esagila temple and eastern annex circa 575 BCE, anchored at the excavation pit. The 29.85 m floor uses two published excavated elevations. The dated local grade is illustrative and preserves the present-day surface in undated viewing. Historical placement requires an explicit viewingDate within the recorded appearance interval; excluded from the default current world.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
